You can target those with significant gaps, pupils who need a confidence boost and those who are working towards greater depth, all at the same time.</p><div class="column2--cta-wrapper"> <a class="yellow--btn column2--cta" href="/ks2-maths-sats-intervention-programme-year-5-6/">Find out about our SATs programme</a></div></div></div></div></div></section><section class="column2--section-grid" id="column-2-6"><div class="container--row overflow--v"><div class="row"><div class="col-6 h-desktop"><h3>Personalise teaching for each pupil</h3><p class="p--small">We assess all pupils online before they start their  intervention programme with Third Space Learning.</p><p class="p--small">This helps us, and you, to choose the most appropriate and beneficial lessons for them to work on with their tutor each week in order to consolidate or move on their learning. After their 45 minute lesson, we assess their understanding and use that to inform future tutoring lessons.</p><div class="column2--cta-wrapper"> <a class="yellow--btn column2--cta" href="/case-studies/">Hear from our schools</a></div></div></div></div></div></section><section class="column2--section-grid" id="column-2-7"><div class="container--row overflow--v"><div class="row"><div class="col-6 column2--order1 h-desktop"><h3>Stay up to date with progress</h3><p class="p--small">You can easily see the content that pupils cover in their online interventions with Third Space.</p><p class="p--small">You’ll be reminded to log in to our online portal every week to see reports from each pupil’s lesson.
